Sonarang Twin Temples

সোনারং জোড়া মঠ

Two soaring brick temple towers overlooking the village of Sonarang.

Get directionsVisiting information

Plan your visit

Location
Tongibari, Munshiganj
How to get there
From Munshiganj town, travel via Tongibari Bazar to Sonarang village. Locally, ask for Sonarang Jora Moth.
Access and opening hours
Published opening hours and interior access are unverified. Check the approach locally and visit in daylight.
Unseen Bangladesh · Sonarang Twin Temples

Published sources reviewed 20 November 2026.

19th century

About this place

The paired 19th-century structures are also known as Sonarong Jora Moth. Their tall, curving towers rise from adjoining platforms and are different in height. Step back to see the composition of both towers together, then look closely at the brick surfaces and arched openings.

Visit in daylight. Use common paths, keep clear of fragile masonry and ask locally about access to the compound.
